summary: URLSession-style HTTP(S) with redirects, download and a memory cache exists, and GCD and ProcessInfo have SDK counterparts. Bonjour, XPC, streams/sockets/ports and Process/NSTask have no app-facing API.

features.feature: URL Loading: sessions, requests, data and download tasks
features.note: shared session, data_task, download_task with progress, upload_task (from data) and upload_task_from_file (streamed) with didSendBodyData progress, countOfBytesSent and countOfBytesExpectedToSend, streaming bytes, redirects up to 5; no background sessions, delegates or configurations

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/url.rs (URLCache); wired: springboard/apps/news-desktop/src/feed_cache.rs (plan, stored_from, max_age_of, validators_of, Conditional)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 13 tests. memory cache honouring Cache-Control and ETag; no disk cache or per-request cache policies Wired into the UI in wiring wave 5 (0.5.43); verify on Midget for parity.

features.feature: URL Loading: cookies, credentials, authentication challenges
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 11 tests. Wave 5 (theme-06, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. cookie jar is internal to the shell HTTP client, not exposed through URLSession

features.feature: URL Loading: WebSocket and streaming tasks
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 14 tests. Wave 5 (w5-foundation-networking-lowlevel, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no WebSocket client in the SDK

features.feature: URL Loading: custom protocols and proxies, URL components
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 15 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. transport is swappable internally for tests only

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/service_discovery.rs, springboard/core/src/dnssd.rs; wired: springboard/core/src/dns_browse.rs via springboard/src/shell/services/network_path.rs (browse only; no advertise)
features.note: Wave 5 (w5-foundation-networking-lowlevel, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no mDNS/DNS-SD code in springboard or the SDK Wired into the UI in wiring wave 2 (0.5.38); verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/control.rs (JSON-RPC over owner-only Unix socket); docs/app-isolation.md
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. control socket serves RPC to an app with SO_PEERCRED check; no general app-to-service connection API or XPC services

features.feature: Object Runtime: exceptions, invocation, KVO, proxies
features.note: Objective-C runtime concepts; Rust has no counterpart. Observation covered by observable.rs

features.feature: Processes and Threads: queues and concurrency
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 29 tests. GCD-style DispatchQueue, group, work item, QoS and a main queue; no OperationQueue or RunLoop

features.feature: Processes and Threads: process information and activity
features.note: memory, cores, uptime, thermal state, low power mode, beginActivity, sudden termination

features.feature: Processes and Threads: launching child processes
features.note: shell launches sandboxed apps under bubblewrap and cgroups; apps get no Process/Pipe wrapper (Rust std::process is available)

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 15 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. std::net and std::io are usable directly; no stream or port abstractions with run-loop scheduling

features.feature: URL Loading: background sessions and download resume data
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. persisted task table per session identifier, Range/If-Range resume, 200 restarts from zero, didWriteData/didFinishDownloadingTo; host unit tests only, not wired into apps, no relaunch events; verify on Midget for parity.

gaps: Cookie storage, credentials and auth challenges in URLSession
